topic.name: 中国与世界
topic.description: 关注中国经济、外交、安全、产业链与海外利益

overview: 今日专题“中国与世界”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: Xi Jinping urges trust-based partnership with Australia in Shenzhen bilateral talks
featured.summary: China and Australia should be “partners that trust each other”, President Xi Jinping told Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese in Shenzhen on Friday. Xi struck an upbeat tone on Beijing’s relationship with Canberra, describing it as “developing steadily” now, in the meeting after the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders’ summit in the southern Chinese city. “China and Australia have neither historical grievances nor fundamental conflicts of interest, and should be partners who trust...
featured.titleZh: 习近平在深圳双边会谈中敦促与澳大利亚建立基于信任的伙伴关系
featured.summaryZh: 习近平主席在深圳会见澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯时表示，中澳应成为相互信任的伙伴。他指出两国没有历史积怨和根本利益冲突，并对双边关系的稳步发展表示肯定。
featured.whyImportant: 中澳领导人的积极表态有助于缓解双边紧张关系，推动两国在经贸等领域的合作。

featured.title: 中国担任2026年亚太经合组织东道主成果清单
featured.titleZh: 中国担任2026年亚太经合组织东道主成果清单
featured.summaryZh: 该报道列举了中国作为2026年亚太经合组织（APEC）东道主所取得的一系列政策与合作成果。清单涵盖了区域经济合作、贸易便利化及可持续发展等多个议题。
featured.whyImportant: 作为东道主，中国通过此次会议展示了其在区域经济治理中的领导力和推动多边合作的意愿。

featured.title: 11-second handshake: Takaichi adopts more proactive approach with Xi at Apec, experts say
featured.summary: Exchanges between top Chinese and Japanese leaders show Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi adopting a far more proactive approach to assert control and seek direct communication, according to body language experts. Over the past two days, the Apec gala in Shenzhen has been the scene of rare in-person, high-level interactions between the two countries’ leaders, the most notable since ties between Beijing and Tokyo became severely strained over Takaichi’s remarks regarding Taiwan in November last...
featured.titleZh: 专家称高市早苗在APEC期间与习近平互动时采取了更主动的姿态
featured.summaryZh: 肢体语言专家指出，日本首相高市早苗在深圳APEC会议期间，通过更主动的姿态寻求与中国领导人的直接沟通。这是自两国关系因台湾问题紧张以来，双方高层罕见的互动。
featured.whyImportant: 日本领导人态度的转变可能预示着中日关系在经历长期低谷后，双方正尝试通过外交接触缓解紧张局势。

featured.title: Record 57% of Primary 1 pupils in Hong Kong admitted to preferred schools in 2027
featured.summary: A record-high 57 per cent of children starting Primary One at Hong Kong’s public or government-subsidised schools in the next academic year have secured a place at their preferred institutions, amid the city’s declining birth rate. But the total number of applicants also dropped to an all-time low – 15 per cent fewer than last year – since data became available more than two decades ago. Most of the students who used the Primary One admission system this year were born in 2021, when Hong Kong’s...
featured.titleZh: 2027年香港小学入学申请：创纪录的57%学生被首选学校录取
featured.summaryZh: 受出生率下降影响，香港小学入学申请人数降至历史最低点。尽管申请人数减少，但仍有创纪录的57%的学生成功进入首选学校。
featured.whyImportant: 人口结构变化正深刻影响香港的教育资源分配，反映出该地区长期面临的人口挑战。

featured.title: New rail links would bring Asean even closer to China. Will Beijing pay to make it happen?
featured.summary: China and Laos marked a milestone in October, as their joint railway line surpassed 100 billion yuan (US$15 billion) in the cumulative value of imports and exports sent by trains. A private celebration for the two countries? Not for long. Cambodia, Thailand, Malaysia and possibly Vietnam are scoping out ways to link up with the nearly five-year-old China-Laos railway – a move that would cut shipping costs and boost business for Chinese exporters in Southeast Asia, a crucial market as Western...
featured.titleZh: 新的铁路连接将使东盟与中国联系更紧密，北京会为此买单吗？
featured.summaryZh: 中老铁路进出口贸易额已突破1000亿元人民币，柬埔寨、泰国、马来西亚及越南等国正寻求与该铁路对接。此举旨在降低运输成本，并为中国出口商在东南亚这一关键市场提供更多机遇。
featured.whyImportant: 区域铁路互联互通的扩展将深化中国与东南亚国家的经济整合，并重塑区域物流格局。

featured.titleZh: 权力博弈与言辞交锋：习特普会谈及历史性APEC峰会解读
featured.summaryZh: 在深圳举行的2026年APEC峰会上，中国、美国和俄罗斯这三个核大国的领导人进行了历史性会谈。此次峰会重点讨论了全球治理及大国关系，引发了国际社会的广泛关注。
featured.whyImportant: 三大核大国领导人的会晤对全球地缘政治稳定及未来国际秩序的走向具有深远影响。

featured.title: 3 needs Hong Kong must meet to be a city where families thrive
featured.summary: Between mid-2025 and mid-2026, fewer than 30,000 babies were born in Hong Kong. It is the first time since records began that the annual total has fallen below this threshold. Against this backdrop, the government has strengthened fertility support in the latest policy address, extending the newborn allowance and enhancing tax concessions for families. These measures matter, but they do not tell the whole story of family formation. Hong Kong has world-class infrastructure and public services,...
featured.titleZh: 香港要成为宜居城市必须满足的三大需求
featured.summaryZh: 香港年度新生儿数量首次跌破3万大关，政府虽已通过增加津贴和税收优惠来支持生育，但仍面临挑战。专家认为，仅靠经济激励不足以解决家庭组建问题，还需改善整体社会环境。
featured.whyImportant: 人口出生率的持续低迷对香港的长期社会发展和劳动力结构构成了严峻挑战。

global.title: Iran war live: Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi Arabia

global.titleZh: 伊朗战争实况：胡塞武装升级对沙特阿拉伯的袭击
global.summaryZh: 胡塞武装发射的导弹袭击了利雅得的金融中心。这场伊朗战争对全球能源市场造成了持久的影响。
global.whyImportant: 该事件标志着地区冲突的进一步升级，并可能对全球能源供应安全产生重大威胁。

global.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
global.summary: Judgment finds ‘intent to destroy a substantial part of the Rohingya population’ after case seen as critical test for dealing with most serious of state crimes Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority during a 2017 military campaign, the world’s highest court has ruled, in a historic and unprecedented decision. The judgment from the international court of justice (ICJ) – which has never previously found a state responsible for genocide – ends a seven-year legal battle that was seen as a critical global test for dealing with the most serious of all state crimes. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 联合国最高法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚少数民族实施了种族灭绝
global.summaryZh: 国际法院裁定缅甸在2017年的军事行动中对罗兴亚人实施了种族灭绝，这是该法院首次认定国家犯下此类罪行。这一历史性裁决结束了长达七年的法律诉讼，被视为处理国家严重罪行的关键测试。
global.whyImportant: 该裁决为国际法处理国家主导的种族灭绝罪行树立了重要先例，并对缅甸的国际声誉产生重大影响。

global.title: 王毅介绍亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议及相关活动成果
global.titleZh: 王毅介绍亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议及相关活动成果
global.summaryZh: 王毅就此次APEC领导人非正式会议的成果进行了介绍。会议重点讨论了区域经济合作及相关议题。
global.whyImportant: 官方对会议成果的总结反映了中国在推动亚太区域经济合作中的立场与主张。

global.title: Texas botches execution of Reinaldo Dennes as staffers struggle to find vein
global.summary: Dennes, 70, was convicted of killing a Houston jeweler, and groaned for an hour after pentobarbital was administered Texas executed Reinaldo Dennes on Thursday in a procedure that took over an hour as prison staffers struggled to find a suitable vein for the two intravenous needles carrying a lethal dose of pentobarbital, a sedative. Dennes, who was found guilty of capital murder in the death of Janos Szucs, a diamond dealer found shot multiple times in his Houston office in January 1996, was the second person put to death in the US on Thursday, after Florida carried out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year, of Thomas Mitchell Overton. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 德克萨斯州执行死刑过程出现失误，工作人员难以找到静脉
global.summaryZh: 70岁的雷纳尔多·丹尼斯在被执行死刑时，因工作人员难以找到合适的静脉注射点，整个过程持续了一个多小时。丹尼斯在注射戊巴比妥后痛苦呻吟，引发了对死刑执行方式的争议。
global.whyImportant: 该事件再次引发了关于美国死刑执行程序人道性及医疗伦理的广泛讨论。

global.title: Trump nominee refuses to call Jan 6 an ‘attack’ at Senate hearing
global.summary: Trump’s nominee to lead the US agency responsible for election security, refused to call the insurrection an attack.
global.titleZh: 特朗普提名人选在参议院听证会上拒绝将1月6日事件称为“袭击”
global.summaryZh: 特朗普提名的美国选举安全机构负责人人选，在参议院听证会上拒绝将1月6日的国会骚乱定性为“袭击”。这一表态在政界引发了强烈反应。
global.whyImportant: 提名人选对关键政治事件的定性反映了美国国内政治极化对政府机构人事任命的影响。

global.title: Financial Street Securities says chairman detained and under investigation on mainland
global.summary: Hong Kong-listed mainland China brokerage Financial Street Securities says its chairman, Zhu Yanhui, has been placed under investigation and detained by mainland authorities in the latest case involving a senior financial executive amid a sweeping anti-corruption campaign. Zhu was being investigated and had been subjected to detention measures, it said in a filing to the Hong Kong stock exchange on Friday that cited a notice issued by the supervisory commission in Beijing’s Xicheng...
global.titleZh: 金融街证券称董事长被内地有关部门留置调查
global.summaryZh: 在港上市的中国内地券商金融街证券发布公告称，其董事长朱延辉已被内地监管部门留置并接受调查。这是中国金融反腐行动中涉及高级管理人员的最新案例。
global.whyImportant: 此举反映了中国金融领域反腐败调查的持续深入，可能对相关金融机构的运营产生影响。

global.title: New page in history? Xi, Trump and Putin summit was more of a footnote
global.summary: Far from the grand ambitions declared in Yalta in 1945, Shenzhen felt like a meeting in search of an agenda It is arguably true, given it was the first such meeting of the leaders of China, Russia and the US, that Thursday’s gathering in Shenzhen deserved the description of “historic”. But in terms of tangible outcomes, it is unlikely to warrant the “new page in the history of diplomacy” that Vladimir Putin claimed had been written, and will instead be consigned to a smallish footnote in any future volume of the 21st century. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 历史新篇章？中、美、俄领导人深圳会晤更像是一个注脚
global.summaryZh: 中、美、俄三国领导人在深圳举行了首次会晤，尽管被冠以“历史性”标签，但实际成果有限。此次会晤在外交史上可能仅被视为一个微小的注脚，而非预期的重大转折。
global.whyImportant: 此次会晤象征意义大于实质意义，显示出大国间在寻求共识方面仍面临巨大挑战。

usa.title: AI models favour US and UK accents, score Chinese and Nigerian ones lowest, study finds
usa.summary: Ask an artificial intelligence model to grade a job interview or test answers, and a person’s accent may change the score. That is according to new University of Washington research that looked at how some of the most advanced AI models rated English speakers with different accents, both on what they said and how they said it. In the scripted tests, every speaker said the same words, and AI models transcribed the accented speech accurately, meaning the models understood the accents just fine....
usa.titleZh: 研究发现AI模型偏好英美口音，对中国和尼日利亚口音评分最低
